subject: ACK discovery-v4 recursive mesh + final reconciliation + conditional 120Hz contracts
body: At final research coordination boundary, re-read AGENT_DISCOVERY v4 and mandatory PRIMARY_MANAGER_RECURSIVE_MESH_V1, FINAL_RECONCILIATION_GATE_V1, MESH_CONTROLLER_ADOPTION_V1, GEN6_DEBUGGING_DATA_GAPS_V1, and CONDITIONAL_120HZ_CONTRACT_V1. Research role remains bounded; durable HOF already published to Manager/Reviewer. The handoff is compatible with the new contracts: exact main SHA, evidence classes, actual-vs-requested 120Hz measurement, explicit diagnostics gap, no production writes, and lane release. Primary final reconciliation must include this completed lane so the Transition Lab 3s-vs-192ms attribution defect is not silently omitted.
